summary: Iteration 245 verified full Katrina four-eyes loop end-to-end. Backend 11/11 pytest green. Frontend flows all green: /financial-control reachable for both احمد1 and مدير, 4 tabs with اعتمادات كاترينا badge showing 28 pending approvals rendered as cards with اعتماد وتنفيذ/رفض buttons; new test approvals show proposer='مدير' (not auto:llm); findings/تدقيق tab loads with 11 open / 12 high-severity items and 11,650 ر.س impact (no runtime error overlay = financial_control router successfully mounted); Katrina chat FAB (unified-assistant-fab) opens drawer and answers 'كم عدد العملاء؟' with '230 عميل' via LLM within ~50s. Full four-eyes cycle exercised: مدير proposed 1 SAR TEST-AGENT expense via /assistant/chat, self-approve returned 403 four_eyes_violation, احمد1 approve returned 200 with journal_id=pdpl-memory-engine and debit account '035 مصروفات عامة وإدارية' (dynamic chart resolver working). Alias endpoints /api/runtime/{approve|commit|rollback}/{id} now return 403 permission_denied when unauthenticated (bot_reviewer bypass closed). Trial balance still balanced after commit: 13,551 = 13,551 (+1 SAR from test expense).

critical_code_review_comments: core/rbac.extract_identity correctly returns all-None when JWT is missing, and resolve_actor+can_approve then produce role='unknown' → 403 permission_denied. Alias endpoints /approve /commit /rollback all call rbac.require BEFORE the resource lookup — behavior confirmed with a cookieless request.

chat_id_from_confirm_response — /assistant/chat returns approval_id inside cards[].data.approval_id (ApprovalCard). Consider also surfacing approval_id at the top level of the executed block for easier programmatic consumption.

Approvals list endpoint returns wrapped envelope {success, data:[...]} while runtime/approve/{id} also wraps in {success, data:{...}} — consistent envelope is good; keep it consistent everywhere (test had to unwrap both).

KatrinaApprovalsTab renders proposer directly from payload — for legacy 'auto:llm' entries it's confusing to non-technical users. Consider mapping auto:llm → 'كاترينا (بلا هوية سابقة)' or hide/flag them.
